asleep.description:
Set while `maxd` has stopped the CLI because it sat idle. The next
message starts it again, and that clears it. A `maxd` from before
leaves this out.

branch.description:
The git branch the agent works on, when `maxd` knows it. In a
container each agent has a worktree on its own branch.

context.description: How full its context window is, when the CLI reports it.

effort.description:
The effort level its next turn runs at, as the CLI names it. None
when it runs at its model's [`ModelChoice::default_effort`], as an
agent started before `maxd` named a level does. A `maxd` from
before [`crate::message::EFFORT_SINCE`] leaves this out.

inbox.description:
Where the agent sits in the sidebar: settled, snoozed or pinned. A
`maxd` from before inboxes leaves this out, and reads as active.

last_activity_at.description: When the agent last produced output or changed activity.

link.description:
Whether `maxd` can reach the agent itself. Decision N-2 shows a
device that answers with an agent that doesn't as purple.

local.description:
What its model server is doing for a local agent: loading, and
prompt and decode speed. Unset for every other agent, and from a
`maxd` from before [`crate::message::LOCAL_MODELS_SINCE`].

model.description: The model it runs, as the CLI names it. Unset for observed agents.

moved.description: Where the agent moved between devices, if it did.

origin.description: Who started it through the agent tools, if anyone did.

parent.description: Set for a sub-agent, and names the agent that started it.

permission.description: The permission mode it runs in. Unset for observed agents.

pid.description:
The CLI's process ID on its device, or inside its container. Unset
for sub-agents and once the process is gone.

pulls.description:
The PRs linked to its work. A `maxd` from before PRs leaves this
out.

running.description:
What the agent started that still runs, and what it waits on. Unset
when there's neither, for sub-agents, and from a `maxd` from before
[`crate::message::PROCESSES_SINCE`].

session.description: The terminal session holding the CLI. Sub-agents have none.

end, to stop the CLI there and continue the session here. A `maxd`
from before leaves this out.

runs the MaxHQ app asks for these, of the device the agent leaves and

BootId.description:
The boot a device or container is on.

Linux reads it from `/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id` and macOS from
`kern.bootsessionuuid`. A new value means the machine restarted since it
was last seen. Incus containers get a fresh one each time they start. The
value is opaque, so it's a string rather than a UUID.

Capabilities.description:
What a device does beyond agents in folders. A client hides what a
device can't do.

acp_agents.description:
Runs local ACP commands, publishes [`crate::acp::AcpAgent`], and
takes `SetAcpAgent` and `DeleteAcpAgent`. A `maxd` from before it
leaves this out, and reads as false.

agent_tools.description:
Runs the agent tools, keeps permissions and access keys, and takes
`CallTool`, `AuthKey`, `GrantPermission`, `RevokePermission`,
`ListPermissions`, `MintKey` and `ListKeys`. A `maxd` from before it
leaves this out, and reads as false.

copy.description:
Lists, fetches and places a checkout's ignored files, and clones
projects into folders, for copying a project to another device. A
`maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

github_checks.description:
Checks its GitHub App when asked, with `CheckGithubApp`. A `maxd`
from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

github_user.description:
Can hold your GitHub sign-in, with `BeginGithubSignIn` and
`CancelGithubSignIn`, and merges and approves with `PullAction`. A
`maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

guest_ssh.description:
Opens SSH sessions with its container workspaces' guests, with
`GuestSshOpen` and `SetGuestSshKey`, for an editor's Remote-SSH. A
`maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

host_spec.description:
Reads its `maxhq-host.toml`, publishes `HostReport`, and takes
`CheckHost` and `ApplyHost`. A `maxd` from before it leaves this
out, and reads as false.

inbox.description:
Keeps its agents' inboxes and takes `SetInbox`. A `maxd` from before
it leaves this out, and reads as false.

library_moves.description:
Takes `SkillsTakeLibrary` and `SkillSourcePush`, and says which of
its library's git sources have commits not pushed. A `maxd` from
before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

load.description:
Answers `ReadLoad` and `ReadDiagnostics`. A `maxd` from before it
leaves this out, and reads as false.

local_models.description:
Runs or reaches model servers for local agents, publishes
[`crate::local_models::ModelServer`] and
[`crate::local_models::LocalModels`], and takes
[`ClientMessage::ModelAction`]. A `maxd` from before it leaves this
out, and reads as false.

moves.description:
Moves workspaces the old scripts made into MaxHQ, publishes `Move`,
and takes `PlanMove`, `RunMoveStep`, `MoveBack` and `RetireMove`. A
`maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

peer_proofs.description:
Takes a `Prove` with the device's own key on a link from another
device, and serves the link only once it has one. A `maxd` from
before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

peers.description:
Links to other devices' `maxd` for agent calls, keeps its own SSH
key, and takes `PeerKey`, `AuthorizePeer`, `RevokePeer` and
`SetPeerBook`. A `maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads as
false.

phones.description:
Pairs phones and pushes to them, publishes `Phone` and `PhoneBook`,
and takes the phone requests, first frames and `SetApnsKey`. A
`maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

proposal_targets.description:
Takes `elsewhere` on `SkillProposalDiff`, and works out where a
proposal goes from its library. A `maxd` from before it leaves this
out, and reads as false.

pulls.description:
Watches the PRs its agents link to and answers `ListPulls`,
`GetPull`, `PullFiles`, `PullComments`, `PullChecks`, `PullsDue`,
`LinkPull` and `UnlinkPull`. A `maxd` from before it leaves this
out, and reads as false.

scheduled_tasks.description:
Runs scheduled tasks and their webhooks, publishes
[`crate::tasks::DeviceTasks`], and takes `SaveTask`, `DeleteTask`,
`RunTaskNow`, `SetHookOn`, `RotateHookToken`, `SetHookSecret`,
`SetHookAddress`, `ListRuns` and `ListDeliveries`. A `maxd` from before it leaves this
out, and reads as false.

skills.description:
Keeps skills for its projects, publishes `SkillLibrary`,
`ProjectSkills` and `SkillProposal`, and takes the skills requests
and uploads to its skill store. A `maxd` from before it leaves this
out, and reads as false.

snapshots.description:
Takes `ListSnapshots` and `RestoreSnapshot` for its container
workspaces. A `maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads as
false.

terminals.description:
Holds terminals for its agents, publishes
[`crate::terminal::Terminal`], and takes the terminal requests and
frames. A `maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

test_hosts.description:
Offers test hosts and leases, publishes `TestHost` and `TestLease`,
and takes `CheckTestHosts`, `BuildTestHost`, `ResetTestHost`,
`EndLease` and `ReadLeaseScreen`. A `maxd` from before it leaves
this out, and reads as false.

tool_installs.description:
Installs and removes tools itself, publishes `AcpRegistry`, and
takes `InstallTool`, `RemoveTool`, `InstallAcpAgent` and
`AcceptLicence`. A `maxd` from before it leaves this out, and reads
as false.

tools.description:
Reports its agent CLIs and updates them with `UpdateTools`. A `maxd`
from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

transfers.description: Takes uploads and serves downloads, per A-14.

tunnels.description: Forwards ports from its agents, per N-6.

updates.description:
Installs a new `maxd` or guest binary with `InstallUpdate`. A `maxd`
from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

workflows.description:
Follows its projects' workflow runs, publishes `WorkflowRun`, and
takes `OpenWorkflow`, `CloseWorkflow` and `NodeDetail`. A `maxd`
from before it leaves this out, and reads as false.

workspaces.description: Creates and runs container workspaces through Incus, per W-1.

out.

capabilities.description:
What the device does, from its last hello. Unset until it has

claim.description:
The device this link's hello named while it waits for you to say
whether that's really the device, because another link already

device.description: The device's ID, once its `maxd` has answered a hello.

name.description: Your name for the device, or its SSH host until you rename it.

network.description:
The network the route goes over, once the client has worked it
out. Unset means a plain network path with nothing to watch.

peer.description:
The overlay network's view of the device, when the device is a peer
on one. It answers whether the device is up before SSH can.

protocol.description:
The newest protocol version the device's `maxd` speaks, from its
last hello. Unset and kept like `capabilities`.

protocol_mismatch.description:
The protocol versions the device's `maxd` speaks, when its last
hello found none in common with this client's. Kept while the link
is down, and unset once a hello agrees.

route.description: How the client reaches it, or the route it tries first while down.

routes.description:
Every route you set for the device, in your order. Empty for a
device with only `route`.

via.description:
The SSH hosts the route passes through first, nearest first, from a
`ProxyJump` or the host a `ProxyCommand` dials. A device behind a
host shares that host's problems.

waiting.description:
The agents with inbox changes waiting in the app's outbox to go out
through this link, in ID order. The client leaves it empty, and the
app's view fills it in.

auto_settle_days.description:
U-8. Days an agent sits idle before auto-settle settles it, from 1 to
90, or 0 for never. A `maxd` from before inboxes leaves this out.

chat_gap_minutes.description:
Minutes since a dispatcher chat's last message after which your next
request starts a fresh chat, or 0 for never, which keeps it in the
chat you're in. A `maxd` from before
[`crate::message::DISPATCHER_CHATS_SINCE`] leaves it out.

claude_artifacts.description:
Whether Claude Code agents on this device may use the claude.ai
artifact tools, which publish, read and change pages on your
claude.ai account. It applies to agents whose CLI starts after it
changes. A `maxd` from before [`crate::message::ARTIFACTS_SINCE`]
leaves it out and always lets them.

claude_effort.description:
The effort level new Claude Code agents start at, or none for each
model's [`ModelChoice::default_effort`]. A `maxd` from before
[`crate::message::EFFORT_SINCE`] leaves it out.

claude_setup_token.description:
Whether this device takes a Claude setup-token: stores it and hands
it to Claude Code agents when they start. It's meant for personal
use and is off unless you turn it on; signing in with `claude` on
the device needs no token. A `maxd` from before this leaves it out,
and always takes one.

continue_claude_at_limit.description:
Whether a Claude Code agent whose turn a usage limit cut off gets a
message to carry on once the limit resets. It's the default for each
agent, which [`Inbox::continue_at_limit`] can turn on or off. A
`maxd` from before this leaves it out, which reads as off.

cursor_usage.description:
Lets a Mac's `maxd` read the Cursor CLI's login from the Keychain
and ask Cursor for the plan's usage this month. Off unless you turn
it on.

default_permission.description: The mode for new agents started without one.

device.description: The device these settings are for.

dispatcher_acts.description:
Whether the dispatcher makes safe changes at once, such as renaming
an agent or turning a task off. Off makes every change a plan item
you confirm. Deleting, stopping a busy agent and granting a
permission ask either way. A `maxd` from before
[`crate::message::DISPATCHER_ADMIN_SINCE`] leaves it out, and its
dispatcher only plans.

history_mib.description:
How much of each agent's history `maxd` keeps, in MiB from
[`HISTORY_MIB`], or 0 for no limit. Past it the oldest items leave
the agent's timeline on this device, though the CLI's own history
keeps them. A `maxd` from before this leaves it out.

idle_release_minutes.description:
Minutes an agent sits idle before `maxd` stops its CLI to free the
memory, or 0 for never. The agent stays as it is and its CLI starts
again for the next message. A `maxd` from before this leaves it out.

keep_awake.description:
When a Mac's `maxd` keeps it from idling to sleep. Other systems
ignore it.

local_models.description:
The device's choices for local models: idle unload, KV cache type,
context size, fewer tools and the default model. A `maxd` from
before [`crate::message::LOCAL_MODELS_SINCE`] leaves it out, and
reads as the defaults.

memory_items.description:
How many of each agent's newest items `maxd` keeps in memory, from
[`MEMORY_ITEMS`]. The rest wait on disk until a client scrolls back.
A `maxd` from before this leaves it out.

network.description:
Whether phones reach this device over the network, and on which
port.

placement.description: How readily new agents go to this device when you don't pick one.

read_other_agents.description:
Whether agents on this device may list and read other agents, here
and on linked devices, without a permission. Starting, messaging,
stopping and moving agents still need one. Off, an agent reads only
agents you attached or quoted, unless its permission reaches them.
A `maxd` from before [`crate::message::READ_RIGHTS_SINCE`] leaves
it out and lets agents read only what they're allowed.

shell_integration.description:
Whether terminals this device opens give zsh, bash and fish hooks
that mark each prompt and command, so MaxHQ can tell commands
apart. Off starts shells as their own startup files say. It applies
to shells opened after it changes. A `maxd` from before
[`crate::message::SHELL_MARKS_SINCE`] leaves it out and adds no
hooks.

skill_library.description:
Whether this device keeps the skill library. None leaves it to the
default, which is that a Mac keeps it and other devices don't.

snooze_at_limit.description: Snoozes an agent that hits a usage limit until the limit resets.

test_hosts.description: The test hosts this device offers.

tool_updates.description:
The CLIs on the device itself that MaxHQ may update. Empty means you
update them yourself. CLIs in container workspaces MaxHQ made update
on their own.

workspace_network.description:
The Incus network new container workspaces join, one of
[`WorkspaceHost::networks`].

workspace_pool.description:
The Incus storage pool new container workspaces live on, one of

An IANA time zone name, such as `Europe/Amsterdam`. The app takes it
from the Mac when you make the task, so a task on a device set to UTC
still runs at the time you typed.
